in_hebrew.name: Terrye
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Terrye הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Terpsichore, meaning 'terpsis' (delight, joy) and 'chore' (dance). Terpsichore was a muse of the arts and music, particularly dance.

in_greek.name: Terrye
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Terpsichore's gift
in_greek.long_meaning: Terrye είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name Terpsichore, meaning 'terpsis' (delight, joy) and 'chore' (dance). Terpsichore was a muse of the arts and music, particularly dance.

in_latin.name: Terrye
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Terpsichore's gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Terrye est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name Terpsichore, meaning 'terpsis' (delight, joy) and 'chore' (dance). Terpsichore was a muse of the arts and music, particularly dance.
